verses.ar: وَكَانَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ كُلُّهَا لِسَانًا وَاحِدًا وَلُغَةً وَاحِدَةً.
verses.kjv: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
verses.web: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

verses.ar: وَحَدَثَ فِي ٱرْتِحَالِهِمْ شَرْقًا أَنَّهُمْ وَجَدُوا بُقْعَةً فِي أَرْضِ شِنْعَارَ وَسَكَنُوا هُنَاكَ.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
verses.web: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ: «هَلُمَّ نَصْنَعُ لِبْنًا وَنَشْوِيهِ شَيًّا». فَكَانَ لَهُمُ ٱللِّبْنُ مَكَانَ ٱلْحَجَرِ، وَكَانَ لَهُمُ ٱلْحُمَرُ مَكَانَ ٱلطِّينِ.
verses.kjv: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
verses.web: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا: «هَلُمَّ نَبْنِ لِأَنْفُسِنَا مَدِينَةً وَبُرْجًا رَأْسُهُ بِٱلسَّمَاءِ. وَنَصْنَعُ لِأَنْفُسِنَا ٱسْمًا لِئَلَّا نَتَبَدَّدَ عَلَى وَجْهِ كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ».
verses.kjv: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top [may reach] unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
verses.web: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

verses.ar: فَنَزَلَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِيَنْظُرَ ٱلْمَدِينَةَ وَٱلْبُرْجَ ٱللَّذَيْنِ كَانَ بَنُو آدَمَ يَبْنُونَهُمَا.
verses.kjv: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
verses.web: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ: «هُوَذَا شَعْبٌ وَاحِدٌ وَلِسَانٌ وَاحِدٌ لِجَمِيعِهِمْ، وَهَذَا ٱبْتِدَاؤُهُمْ بِٱلْعَمَلِ. وَٱلْآنَ لَا يَمْتَنِعُ عَلَيْهِمْ كُلُّ مَا يَنْوُونَ أَنْ يَعْمَلُوهُ.
verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Behold, the people [is] one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
verses.web: Yahweh said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

verses.ar: هَلُمَّ نَنْزِلْ وَنُبَلْبِلْ هُنَاكَ لِسَانَهُمْ حَتَّى لَا يَسْمَعَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِسَانَ بَعْضٍ».
verses.kjv: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.
verses.web: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

verses.ar: فَبَدَّدَهُمُ ٱلرَّبُّ مِنْ هُنَاكَ عَلَى وَجْهِ كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ، فَكَفُّوا عَنْ بُنْيَانِ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ،
verses.kjv: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
verses.web: So Yahweh scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ دُعِيَ ٱسْمُهَا «بَابِلَ» لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ هُنَاكَ بَلْبَلَ لِسَانَ كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ. وَمِنْ هُنَاكَ بَدَّدَهُمُ ٱلرَّبُّ عَلَى وَجْهِ كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
verses.web: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth. From there, Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

verses.ar: هَذِهِ مَوَالِيدُ سَامٍ: لَمَّا كَانَ سَامٌ ٱبْنَ مِئَةِ سَنَةٍ وَلَدَ أَرْفَكْشَادَ، بَعْدَ ٱلطُّوفَانِ بِسَنَتَيْنِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ These [are] the generations of Shem: Shem [was] an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
verses.web: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ سَامٌ بَعْدَ مَا وَلَدَ أَرْفَكْشَادَ خَمْسَ مِئَةِ سَنَةٍ، وَوَلَدَ بَنِينَ وَبَنَاتٍ.
verses.kjv: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.web: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ أَرْفَكْشَادُ خَمْسًا وَثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً وَوَلَدَ شَالَحَ.
verses.kjv: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
verses.web: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ أَرْفَكْشَادُ بَعْدَ مَا وَلَدَ شَالَحَ أَرْبَعَ مِئَةٍ وَثَلَاثَ سِنِينَ، وَوَلَدَ بَنِينَ وَبَنَاتٍ.
verses.kjv: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.web: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ شَالَحُ ثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً وَوَلَدَ عَابِرَ.
verses.kjv: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
verses.web: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ شَالَحُ بَعْدَ مَا وَلَدَ عَابِرَ أَرْبَعَ مِئَةٍ وَثَلَاثَ سِنِينَ، وَوَلَدَ بَنِينَ وَبَنَاتٍ.
verses.kjv: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.web: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ عَابِرُ أَرْبَعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً وَوَلَدَ فَالَجَ.
verses.kjv: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
verses.web: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ عَابِرُ بَعْدَ مَا وَلَدَ فَالَجَ أَرْبَعَ مِئَةٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً، وَوَلَدَ بَنِينَ وَبَنَاتٍ.
verses.kjv: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.web: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ فَالَجُ ثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً وَوَلَدَ رَعُوَ.
verses.kjv: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
verses.web: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ فَالَجُ بَعْدَ مَا وَلَدَ رَعُوَ مِئَتَيْنِ وَتِسْعَ سِنِينَ، وَوَلَدَ بَنِينَ وَبَنَاتٍ.
verses.kjv: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.web: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ رَعُو ٱثْنَتَيْنِ وَثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً وَوَلَدَ سَرُوجَ.
verses.kjv: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
verses.web: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ رَعُو بَعْدَ مَا وَلَدَ سَرُوجَ مِئَتَيْنِ وَسَبْعَ سِنِينَ، وَوَلَدَ بَنِينَ وَبَنَاتٍ.
verses.kjv: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.web: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ سَرُوجُ ثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً وَوَلَدَ نَاحُورَ.
verses.kjv: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
verses.web: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ سَرُوجُ بَعْدَ مَا وَلَدَ نَاحُورَ مِئَتَيْ سَنَةٍ، وَوَلَدَ بَنِينَ وَبَنَاتٍ.
verses.kjv: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.web: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ نَاحُورُ تِسْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ سَنَةً وَوَلَدَ تَارَحَ.
verses.kjv: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
verses.web: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ نَاحُورُ بَعْدَ مَا وَلَدَ تَارَحَ مِئَةً وَتِسْعَ عَشَرَةَ سَنَةً، وَوَلَدَ بَنِينَ وَبَنَاتٍ.
verses.kjv: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.web: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

verses.ar: وَعَاشَ تَارَحُ سَبْعِينَ سَنَةً، وَوَلَدَ أَبْرَامَ وَنَاحُورَ وَهَارَانَ.
verses.kjv: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.web: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ مَوَالِيدُ تَارَحَ: وَلَدَ تَارَحُ أَبْرَامَ وَنَاحُورَ وَهَارَانَ. وَوَلَدَ هَارَانُ لُوطًا.
verses.kjv: ¶ Now these [are] the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
verses.web: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

verses.ar: وَمَاتَ هَارَانُ قَبْلَ تَارَحَ أَبِيهِ فِي أَرْضِ مِيلَادِهِ فِي أُورِ ٱلْكَلْدَانِيِّينَ.
verses.kjv: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
verses.web: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.

verses.ar: وَٱتَّخَذَ أَبْرَامُ وَنَاحُورُ لِأَنْفُسِهِمَا ٱمْرَأَتَيْنِ: ٱسْمُ ٱمْرَأَةِ أَبْرَامَ سَارَايُ، وَٱسْمُ ٱمْرَأَةِ نَاحُورَ مِلْكَةُ بِنْتُ هَارَانَ، أَبِي مِلْكَةَ وَأَبِي يِسْكَةَ.
verses.kjv: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram’s wife [was] Sarai; and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
verses.web: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

verses.ar: وَكَانَتْ سَارَايُ عَاقِرًا لَيْسَ لَهَا وَلَدٌ.
verses.kjv: But Sarai was barren; she [had] no child.
verses.web: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

verses.ar: وَأَخَذَ تَارَحُ أَبْرَامَ ٱبْنَهُ، وَلُوطًا بْنَ هَارَانَ، ٱبْنَ ٱبْنِهِ، وَسَارَايَ كَنَّتَهُ ٱمْرَأَةَ أَبْرَامَ ٱبْنِهِ، فَخَرَجُوا مَعًا مِنْ أُورِ ٱلْكَلْدَانِيِّينَ لِيَذْهَبُوا إِلَى أَرْضِ كَنْعَانَ. فَأَتَوْا إِلَى حَارَانَ وَأَقَامُوا هُنَاكَ.
verses.kjv: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
verses.web: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

verses.ar: وَكَانَتْ أَيَّامُ تَارَحَ مِئَتَيْنِ وَخَمْسَ سِنِينَ. وَمَاتَ تَارَحُ فِي حَارَانَ.
verses.kjv: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
verses.web: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.
